;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**[[Japan]] warns on Saturday that the new [[North Korea|North Korean]] projectiles have trajectories that are not typical for conventional [[ballistic missiles]], making them difficult or impossible to intercept en route to Japan. [http://english.almanar.com.lb/791133 (Al-Manar)]
*[[2019 Borno funeral attack]]
**At least 65 people are killed and 10 injured in an attack by [[Boko Haram]] at a funeral in [[Maiduguri]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/07/28/africa/boko-haram-attack-nigeria/index.html (CNN)]  
;Law and crime
*Two [[Americans|American]] teenagers are arrested in [[Rome]] for [[extortion]] and murder of an [[Italian Armed Forces|Italian military officer]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/27/world/europe/italy-police-officer-murder-americans.html (''The New York Times'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] and the [[Parliament of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese parliament]], controlled by a rival party, agree to form a new government following negotiations, six months after he replaced [[Joseph Kabila]] during the [[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election|2018 DR Congo general election]]. [[Sylvestre Ilunga]] will be formally nominated for the post of [[Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Prime Minister]] in the coming week. [https://www.news24.com/Africa/News/dr-congo-rivals-forge-government-pact-7-months-after-polls-20190726 (News24)]
*Venezuela's [[Nicolás Maduro]] again accuses the [[United States]] of flying over its national waters. [https://www.elsoldemexico.com.mx/mundo/justifica-eu-espionaje-aereo-en-venezuela-3962750.html (''El Sol de Mexico'')]
*[[2019 Moscow City Duma election]]
**Several thousand people attend a rally in [[Moscow]] organized by [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|opposition members]] due to several opposition candidates being disqualified from regional elections. The protests turned violent and [[Police of Russia|police]] detained about 1,000 people, including politician [[Alexei Navalny]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49125045 (BBC News)]
